name: Business Current Account Opening — Participant Interaction
description: Defines, for each phase of JRN-004, what each participant can see (data projection), what actions they can take (entitlements), and what communications they receive (notifications). Covers: PER-002 (Business Customer — primary applicant), PER-050 (Relationship Manager — complex structures and EDD assisted path), PER-052 (MLRO — EDD referrals and sanctions hits). Note: directors and UBOs who are not the primary applicant receive secure verification invitations; their interaction is limited to PH-142 (Identity Verification) only.

projection.description: Business applicant sees the business account opening application form. Required fields: legal entity type, company name, Companies House registration number, registered address, trading address (if different), trading name (if applicable), SIC codes. Applicant selects account type.
data_fields_visible: Provisional application reference (system-generated)
Account type options and associated features/fees
Entity type selector (limited company | LLP | partnership | sole trader)
Product terms and conditions summary
BBRS dispute resolution scheme availability notice
FSCS eligibility summary (sole traders only — limited companies generally ineligible)
data_not_visible: System fraud signals captured in background

actions_permitted: Complete and submit company registration details
Select entity type
Select account type
Save application progress (session-bound, 48-hour expiry for business applications)
Abandon application
Request Relationship Manager assistance
actions_not_permitted: Skip mandatory company registration fields
Submit application for an entity type not supported without RM referral
View other business customers' data

notifications.content: Your business account application has been started. Reference: [application_ref]. We will now verify your company details with Companies House. This usually takes a few seconds. We will guide you through the next steps.
This entity type may require additional support. A Relationship Manager will contact you within 1 business day to continue your application.

projection.description: The applicant sees confirmation that the Companies House lookup has completed successfully, along with the verified company details retrieved. Any discrepancies are surfaced for the applicant to confirm or correct.
data_fields_visible: Verified company name (from Companies House)
Companies House registration number
Registered address (from Companies House)
Company incorporation date
Company status (confirmed: active)
SIC codes (for applicant confirmation)
data_fields_masked: Director names (shown on confirmation screen in PH-141, not during CH lookup)
data_not_visible: Internal risk flags based on SIC code

actions_permitted: Confirm or correct company details retrieved from Companies House
Confirm trading name if different from registered name
Confirm principal trading address
actions_not_permitted: Override Companies House-verified legal name without RM escalation
Proceed if Companies House status is not active

notifications.content: We have verified your company with Companies House. Please confirm the details below are correct before proceeding.
notifications.timing: Immediate on successful CH API response

notifications.content: We are having difficulty reaching Companies House right now. Your application has been saved — we will continue the verification automatically and notify you when complete. This usually resolves within 30 minutes.

projection.description: The applicant sees the list of directors and Persons with Significant Control (PSCs) retrieved from Companies House. They are asked to confirm the list is complete, declare any additional beneficial owners not appearing in the PSC register, and confirm ownership percentages for each UBO.
data_fields_visible: Director list: name, appointment date (from Companies House)
PSC list: name, ownership type, approximate ownership percentage (from Companies House)
Confirmation prompt for each director/UBO: 'Is this person still an active director/UBO?'
Declaration field: 'Are there any beneficial owners with >25% not listed above?'
Contact detail collection fields for each director/UBO not already in bank records (for verification invitation)
data_not_visible: Automated risk flags on individual directors
PEP screening results (not yet run at this phase)

actions_permitted: Confirm each director and UBO as listed
Declare additional beneficial owners not in Companies House PSC register
Provide contact details (email) for each director/UBO who requires a verification invitation
Mark a director as 'no longer a director' (where Companies House data may be stale)
Confirm ownership percentages for each UBO
actions_not_permitted: Remove a director from the list without declaring a reason (change is flagged for review)
Claim 0% ownership for an individual listed in the PSC register without RM/MLRO review
Proceed without completing the UBO declaration

notifications.content: Thank you for confirming your company's ownership structure. We will now need to verify the identity of each director and beneficial owner. Each person will receive a secure link by email to complete their identity check.

We have identified that one of your beneficial owners is itself a company. To comply with anti-money laundering regulations, we need additional information about the ownership of that company. A Relationship Manager will contact you within 1 business day.
notifications.timing: On detection of corporate PSC entry

projection.description: The primary applicant sees a real-time dashboard showing the identity verification status for each director and UBO. Their own verification can be completed immediately in-app. Others receive email invitations.
data_fields_visible: List of directors/UBOs requiring identity verification with status: pending | in_progress | complete | failed
Applicant's own identity verification flow (Onfido/Jumio SDK — document capture + liveness)
Elapsed time and expected SLA for each pending verification
Resend invitation button for pending verifications
data_fields_masked: Document numbers of other directors/UBOs — not visible to applicant
data_not_visible: Identity verification outcome details for other individuals (privacy — applicant sees only pass/fail status)

actions_permitted: Complete their own identity verification (document upload + liveness check)
View overall verification status for all required individuals
Resend verification invitation to a director/UBO
Flag a director/UBO as 'unreachable' (triggers RM intervention)
Retry their own identity verification (up to 2 retries)
actions_not_permitted: Complete identity verification on behalf of another director or UBO
View other individuals' document numbers, biometric scores, or verification provider details

notifications.content: All identity verifications are complete. We are now completing the compliance checks on your company. This usually takes 1–2 business days. We will contact you as soon as we have an update.

notifications.trigger: Verification invitation not completed after 48 hours
notifications.content: The identity verification link we sent to [name] has not yet been completed. Please ask them to check their email and complete the verification, or contact us if you need assistance.
notifications.timing: 48 hours after invitation dispatch, if status is still pending

notifications.content: Your identity has been verified successfully. Waiting for the remaining [n] director/UBO verifications to complete.

projection.description: The primary applicant sees a 'compliance checks in progress' holding screen. They are not shown any detail of the specific checks being performed (tipping-off prevention).
data_fields_visible: Application status: 'Compliance checks in progress'
Expected completion timeframe: 'This usually takes 1–2 business days'
Case reference number
Contact details for the Relationship Management team if the applicant has questions
data_not_visible: PEP screening results for any individual
EDD referral status (if triggered — applicant is told 'additional checks required' without specifics)

actions_permitted: View application status
Contact Relationship Manager
actions_not_permitted: View CDD assessment details
Expedite or override the compliance assessment

notifications.content: Good news — our compliance checks are complete. We are now preparing your account decision. You should hear from us within 1 business day.

Our compliance team needs a little more information before we can complete your application. A Relationship Manager will contact you within 1 business day. Your case reference is [ref]. We aim to complete additional checks within 10 business days.
notifications.timing: On BusinessKYCReferralRaised event — no mention of specific EDD trigger reason

projection.description: The primary applicant receives the account decision outcome.
data_fields_visible: Decision outcome: Approved | Referred | Declined
If approved: next steps (account setup instructions)
If declined: plain-language decline message, BBRS referral signpost (if eligible SME), FOS signpost where applicable
Application reference
data_not_visible: KYC risk score or risk category

actions_permitted: Accept the approved application and proceed to account setup
Acknowledge decline notification
Request BBRS review (decline cases for eligible SME customers)
Contact Relationship Manager for referred cases
actions_not_permitted: Appeal automated KYC/CDD decision directly
View internal decision rationale

notifications.content: Congratulations — your business account application has been approved. We are now setting up your account. Your sort code and account number will be ready shortly.

We are unable to open a business account for [company name] at this time. We are sorry we cannot be more specific about the reason — this is to comply with our legal obligations. If you believe this decision was made in error, you can contact the Business Banking Resolution Service (BBRS) for an independent review if your business has a turnover under £10 million. For complaints, please visit [complaints URL].

projection.description: The primary applicant sees the account details confirmation screen as the account is being provisioned.
data_fields_visible: Account number (8-digit, allocated)
Sort code (XX-XX-XX format)
IBAN
BIC
Account name (legal entity name)
Multi-signatory configuration summary (who can authorise payments, payment approval thresholds)

actions_permitted: View account details
Download account opening confirmation
Proceed to digital banking setup
actions_not_permitted: Modify multi-signatory configuration at this stage (post-opening configuration change journey required)
Add additional authorised users at this stage (separate onboarding invitation flow available post-opening)

notifications.content: Your business account is ready. Account name: [company name]. Sort code: [XX-XX-XX]. Account number: [XXXXXXXX]. IBAN: [GB..]. You can now set up your online banking access.

projection.description: The primary applicant sets up business banking portal credentials and biometric SCA. The business portal welcome dashboard shows account details, payment capabilities, and an onboarding checklist.
data_fields_visible: Business banking portal welcome dashboard
Account number, sort code, IBAN, BIC
Payment rails available: BACS, Faster Payments, CHAPS
Authorised user roster and roles
Payment approval workflow configuration
Onboarding checklist: set up payees, configure payment approvals, invite additional users, set up direct debits

actions_permitted: Create portal username and password
Enrol biometric SCA (Face ID / fingerprint via FIDO2/WebAuthn)
Complete first login via SCA
View account details and onboarding checklist
Invite additional authorised users via email
actions_not_permitted: Make payments before SCA enrolment is complete
Access other users' portal sessions

notifications.content: Welcome to [Bank] Business Banking. Your account is now fully active. Here are your account details: [sort code, account number, IBAN]. Your Relationship Manager is [name] and can be reached at [contact details]. We have attached your account opening confirmation and terms.

participants.description: Relationship Manager (RM) has read access to the full application state in the commercial banking CRM. The RM can assist PER-002 with complex applications, facilitate UBO documentation gathering for EDD, and progress referred applications. The RM cannot override CDD/KYC compliance outcomes — only MLRO can.

projection.description: RM can view and pre-populate the business account application on behalf of PER-002 in the commercial banking CRM.
data_fields_visible: Full application form (all fields)
PER-002 contact details
Companies House pre-populated data (if CRM has CH integration)
Application status and phase

actions_permitted: Initiate a new business account application on behalf of a customer
Pre-populate company details
Submit application on behalf of PER-002 (with customer written consent)
Flag application for RM-assisted path
actions_not_permitted: Override eligibility rules
Bypass Companies House verification

notifications.content: New business account application [ref] has been referred for RM assistance. Company: [company name]. Action required within 2 business days.

projection.description: RM is assigned EDD cases to facilitate document gathering from PER-002.
data_fields_visible: EDD case details: specific information required
Reason category for EDD (PEP director, high-risk jurisdiction, complex structure — internal)
Document checklist for EDD (source of funds, corporate structure chart, board resolution)
MLRO case status

actions_permitted: Contact PER-002 to request EDD documentation
Upload received documents to the EDD case
Update EDD case status
Escalate to MLRO with documentation received
actions_not_permitted: Make the EDD approval decision
Override MLRO CDD assessment
View specific PEP match details (MLRO-only)

notifications.content: EDD case [ref] has been assigned to you. Company: [company name]. Additional information required. Please contact the customer and gather the listed documentation within 5 business days.

projection.description: RM can view referred application cases and provide their recommendation to the decision engine or to MLRO.
data_fields_visible: Full application data for the referred case
Referral reason (internal category — not disclosed to customer)
CDD assessment summary (non-PEP/sanctions detail — for RM visibility)
RM recommendation field
data_fields_masked: Specific PEP match details — MLRO only
Specific sanctions match details — MLRO only

actions_permitted: View referred application details
Submit RM recommendation (approve / refer to MLRO / escalate for decline)
Contact PER-002 regarding the referred application
actions_not_permitted: Make final approval/decline decision for referred applications with compliance flags
View raw PEP or sanctions screening results

notifications.content: Referred business account application [ref] requires your review and recommendation. Action required within 2 business days.

participants.description: MLRO has full read access to all CDD/KYC data, PEP/sanctions screening results, and EDD case files. The MLRO is the sole decision-maker for EDD approvals, sanctions-hit resolutions, and UBO identification exceptions. The MLRO has personal accountability under POCA 2002 and MLR 2017 SMF17.

projection.description: MLRO has full visibility of all compliance data for the case.
data_fields_visible: Full BusinessKycAssessment record including all screening results
PEP match details: name, position, country, data source (ComplyAdvantage/World-Check)
Sanctions screening details: match confidence, list(s) matched
Adverse media summary and severity rating
All individual director/UBO CDD results
EDD documentation uploaded by RM
UBO ownership structure diagram
Company risk score and category
MLRO sign-off field with audit timestamp

actions_permitted: Approve EDD case (BusinessKYCCleared published on sign-off)
Decline EDD case (BusinessApplicationDecisionMade outcome: declined)
Request further information from RM
Impose risk conditions on account (e.g. enhanced monitoring, turnover limits)
File SAR with NCA UKFIU if suspicion arises during EDD review
Access OFSI reporting workflow for confirmed sanctions matches
actions_not_permitted: Approve a case where UBO cannot be identified to the required standard
Approve a case with an unresolved confirmed OFSI/OFAC sanctions match

notifications.content: EDD case [ref] requires MLRO review. Company: [company name]. Trigger: [PEP director | high-risk jurisdiction | complex structure]. Case must be resolved within 10 business days of application date.

notifications.channel: Case management system URGENT alert + Email
notifications.content: URGENT — Sanctions hit detected on business account application [ref]. Company: [company name]. Action required within 1 business day. OFSI reporting obligation may apply (within 14 days if confirmed).
